prior_family.status: prespecified_conditions_fail unchanged; no discarded repeats or modified prior rules

question: Does the frozen pipeline/capacity structure predict deeper legally queued resident work and its difference from completion-serialized work under explicitly controlled occurrence history?

model_scope.source_interfaces: same selected public custom ISA/FENCE and coherent readout
model_scope.preflight_support: Configured structure supports WS pairing/queue release/controller and reservation accounting. Actual selected-window completeness and no unresolved feature are REQUIRED; static support is not qualification.
model_scope.unsupported: No claim for translation misses/cache replacement ground truth, tail/transpose/accumulate/FP or whole SoC accuracy.

capacity_interpretation.limit: Issued command count exceeds selected capacities; actual simultaneous occupancy/backpressure is not inferred. CPU issue may prevent saturation. Observe model resource events when available and label missing occupancy UNKNOWN.

protocol.initial_state: All11A/B loaded/configured and drained once per arm. Same A/output addresses reused across arms; first is first ARM use, never asserted coldcache.
protocol.warm_state: Before each of two warm measurements execute exact same mode/depth untimed, drain, verify every output, then write all output sentinels/guards and fence. Same sequence per warm occurrence.
protocol.output_state: All11 output tiles sentinel-initialized before each measured/untimed execution; active results and inactive sentinels checked;32 guards each time.
protocol.reference: Independent CPU integer multiplication outside windows, exact all elements; no downloaded source/golden.
protocol.printing: Only after24 measured windows; fullprogram errors also aggregate16 untimed warmup checks.
protocol.operations_inside_window: Execute pair(s), optional per-pair completionFENCE, common execute completionFENCE, queuedMVOUTs, finalFENCE; CSR bracketing.
protocol.not_additive: Paired durations are inclusive; no inferred physical stage decomposition.

acceptance.functional: All24 windows plus16 unmeasured warmups exact outputs/inactive sentinels/guards. Ordinary/annotated semantics equal excluding cycles.
acceptance.observation: Every selected scope timing_complete true/unresolved empty, exact ELF/input/model/provider/config/source/plan pins. No favorable fallback.
acceptance.per_occurrence: Each of24 predictions error <=max(32cycles,20%RTL); median relative error across24<=15%. First occurrence stays included.
acceptance.warm_stability: For each arm only two identically prewarmed occurrences: abs(warm1-warm2)/mean <=5%; failure remains failure. First-use state is separately labeled and never retrospectively discarded.
acceptance.paired_throughput: For each depth and each occurrence, predicted queued/serialized ratio relative error<=15%; correct faster/slower sign if physical separation>max(32cycles,5%slow).
acceptance.depth_slope: For each mode and warm occurrence, depth increments1to3,3to7,7to11: predicted delta residual<=max(32cycles,25%abs physicaldelta); no claimed saturation unless matched occupancy evidence supports it.
acceptance.state_delta: For each arm first_minus_mean_warm prediction residual<=max(32cycles,25%abs physicaldelta). No attribution to a cache without independent counters.
acceptance.qualification: All gates conjunctive, only narrow observed region. Existing denominator/heldout/fit prerequisites remain; one related protocol family is not four independent workloads.
acceptance.failure: Keep original model/denial unchanged. If results guide model edits this family becomes development and a new independent validation family is needed.

budget.ledger: Existing cumulative diagnostic ledger only, no reset
budget.authorization: No physical launch until ordinary+allannotated scopes complete and parent reviews exact artifacts

independence.lineage: New protocol/source and deterministic operands, related public fulltile ISA scaffold; previous labels informed question selection but no new labels used for code/model/threshold tuning.
